annotations.text:
Click any column's Expand button, or any icon in the left rail.
The chosen column takes the full stage; the rest collapse into the rail.
Pull Requests and My Work are stage-only — they open straight to widescreen.

The Bitbucket table is the reason this pattern exists: five columns of PR data
are unreadable in a half-width grid cell. Everything else fits narrow.

The one thing worth building now is the TerrainSource seam.
DomTerrain today, ScreenTerrain later — the avatar never learns the difference,
so walking the desktop costs a new class, not a physics rewrite.
